<!--
  Thank you for your interest in FreeSDN.

  Please read this before submitting: FreeSDN is developed in-house by the
  small team that runs it in production, and does NOT accept external code
  contributions. Pull requests will be closed unmerged. This keeps the supply
  chain controlled and the architecture coherent, explained in full in
  CONTRIBUTING.md. It is about a controlled security surface, not about your work.

  There is a lot you CAN do instead:

  - Found a bug?            Open a Bug report issue.
  - Want a feature/adapter? Open a Feature request issue.
  - Have a question?        Start a Discussion.
  - Found a vulnerability?  Use the private advisory flow in SECURITY.md.
  - Want a vendor supported?Donate the hardware (see DONATE.md) - that is the
                            fastest path, since adapters are built and tested
                            against real devices.
  - Want to extend FreeSDN? Build a plugin with the FreeSDN SDK in your own
                            repo - no PR to this repo required.

  If you still want to open this PR as a reference for a bug report or feature
  request, that is fine - link it from the relevant issue and it will be read,
  but it will not be merged.
-->

This repository does not accept pull requests. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the why and for the ways to help that
are welcome (bug reports, feature requests, hardware donations, plugins).
